eventDetail.scope: The ISASR-2026 conference aims to bring together researchers, industry practitioners, and policy experts to explore state-of-the-art innovations in Internet of Things (IoT), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Advanced Sensor Networks, and Management of Intelligent Systems. The focus is on how these technologies converge to create sustainable, scalable, secure, and autonomous systems that address major societal and economic challenges. Aligned with emerging global technology priorities such as collaborative sensing, integrated sensing and communication, edge-AI ecosystems, and trustworthy AI systems, this conference highlights research with real-world societal impact.
